notes.title: 2025.7.4aUpdate
notes.notes:
1. Updated with a brand new free skin DLC "DodgeShow - Generation 2: Ionia I", featuring a newly drawn map "Wuju Sword Tomb" and the character "Little Wukong". A grind-intensive masterpiece, enjoy to your heart's content\~
2. Significantly reduced the difficulty of gaining experience points (The developers realized that, in a casual game, level progression shouldn’t be a barrier to unlocking new content).
3. Significantly reduced the difficulty of earning achievements (The developers realized once again, achievements are now more linear and accessible).

notes.title: 2025.4.1b.Update
notes.notes: 1. Fixed the issue where selecting skill-less training dummies in custom mode would cause an error when not at max level.

notes.title: 2025.4.1aUpdate
notes.notes:
1. Version update gives 10,000 experience points.  
2. Level cap increased by 2 levels, with 2 new training dummies: Janna and Sona. These can be obtained after upgrading from the original level.  
3. Optimization: 4 training dummies without skills have been added to the custom mode.  
4. Optimization: BGM will now pause when the game is paused.  
5. Optimization: The mouse will no longer be restricted to the game window when the game is paused. (Tip: Hold down the Alt key to free the mouse in-game.)  
6. Removed some debug remnants from development.  
7. Fixed the daily first-game reward notification bug.

notes.title: 2025.3.15a.Update
notes.notes:
1. Added a new option allowing you to choose whether to start the game as the first or second edition using the "Manage DLC" feature in Steam. For example, by disabling the DLC, the game will launch the previous first edition version.  
2. New training dummy preview: Head to Custom Mode and check out who’s been added!

notes.title: 2025.3.12a Update
notes.notes: 1. Fixed the issue where using the item *Stormbringer* caused the game to freeze.

notes.title: 2025.2.28a Updata
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue with cloud save not working. You can now use the Steam cloud feature normally.  
2. The previously added prediction feature seemed a bit too strict. Now, the training dummies are more flexible, making more random choices between prediction or not, and prediction distance.

notes.title: 2025.2.23a.Updata
notes.notes:
1. Lowered the difficulty of Hell Mode.  
2. Fixed the issue where the training dummies were not fully displayed on the Hell Mode settlement page.  
3. Optimized the training dummy prediction logic.  
4. Fixed the incorrect sound effect for Big Head's skill.  
5. Fixed the abnormal sound effect for Ezreal's Q ability.  
6. Reduced Sejuani's damage.

notes.title: 2025.2.21c.Updata
notes.notes:
1. Players have generally reported that the difficulty is too low, so we've added a prediction feature. From now on, all training dummies' skills will land precisely where you might move next. As a result, your survival time might be significantly shortened (haha, a bit of developer mischief).
2.Fix bugs

notes.title: 2025.2.21b.Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue where the count in Brawl Mode didn’t update.  
2. Summoner Spell: Heal cooldown increased to 15 seconds.

notes.title: 2025.2.21Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug where an error occurred during the settlement in Brawl Mode when the time exceeded 200 seconds.
2. Added injury effects for a stronger sense of impact.

notes.title: 2025.2.20Update Content
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the issue where notifications should not appear in the Heart of Steel Desk Pet mode.
2. Added the functionality to click and jump to DLC links from the character and map UI interfaces.
3. Added the feature to hide the taskbar icon in Heart of Steel Desk Pet mode.

notes.title: 《DodgeShow2》is here! More beautiful, more immersive, and more fun!
notes.notes:
[b]After acquiring the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492000/DodgeShow2/?beta=0]<DodgeShow2-Generation 2 Upgrade Pack>[/url]DLC, the game will be upgraded to the all-new <DodgeShow2>![/b]

[b]About the visual and auditory aspects of 《DodgeShow2》:[/b]
The original design of the game was aimed at training players' reaction times in a familiar environment. However, due to the limitations of the technology at the time, the first edition was a bit rushed.  
In <DodgeShow2>, we’ve redrawn the character models, scenes, and UI to a higher standard, bringing a more immersive and familiar sound effect and BGM, creating an entirely new gaming experience in both visuals and sound!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32525153/2d12931041ede213e41c971b631f43be017613da.png[/img]

The protagonist and map skins will be updated in DLC form, with the first DLC [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3500500/DodgeShow2I/?beta=0]<DodgeShow-Generation2-DemaⅠ>[/url] launching with this update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32525153/95d448229163730b2b55197592e7a634930bf41a.jpg[/img]

[b]About the game mechanics in <DodgeShow2>:[/b]
1. <Dodging and positioning> are the core of the series. To enhance this core, <DodgeShow2> introduces the familiar "training dummies" that we all know. All the skills players need to dodge are now performed by five training dummies. This design expands the map boundaries and makes the experience feel much more like the games we’re familiar with! New training dummies will also be updated regularly!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32525153/88952cce9a296900d6d281c7288c0b85bbfc7bf8.png[/img]

2. Players can freely combine a wider range of equipment and skills to last longer!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32525153/09fbd8836a2e491fde2c49781732aabf8c76f496.jpg[/img]

3. We offer more game modes: Classic Mode, Brawl Mode, and Custom Mode, along with occasional updates for rotating fun modes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32525153/4ff7cbb836cdd1485f233d05a6fd5826a6369ce6.png[/img]

4. Desktop Heart of Steel gameplay! I like to call it a cyber de-stress toy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32525153/4e3e00db8c72838c7c3cd7b58146579ddf0d4861.jpg[/img]

Now, if you're interested, feel free to give it a try!  
If you're not satisfied, feel free to leave a negative review and request a refund—no hard feelings. But if you enjoy it and would like to leave a review, I’d be greatly appreciative!
